subject: Relational operators
notes: kb/Work PB1034 LANDED (wave 1005 D). Rule 8.7.5.2 SR2 (Format 2 specifies extended relational operators); the observable consequence is that the extended set is the printed one and no more. comparisonOperator used to admit NOT >=, NOT <=, NOT ... OR EQUAL and EQUAL THAN as extended operators. It now holds exactly 8.8.4.2.2 Format 1's alternatives (rendered page PDF p217): [NOT] on GREATER THAN, >, LESS THAN, <, EQUAL TO and = only, EQUAL's optional word TO. The five extra spellings are parse errors in every consumer (IF, EVALUATE, PERFORM UNTIL, SEARCH WHEN, abbreviated tails, >>IF). The 8.8.4.12.4 NOTE spellings (NOT < / NOT > in abbreviated position) are printed extended operators and still evaluate by the NOTE table (l1_perform_until_condition_forms). Witnesses: pb1034_printed_relational_operator_set (every printed spelling, values from 8.8.4.2.4), the pb1034-* negatives, and RelationalOperatorFormatDriftTests, which expands the grammar rule into spellings and requires them to equal the printed set. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Procedure/Verbs/ConditionBinder.cs#InGeneralRelationFormat (kb/Work PB1034 deleted InGeneralRelationFormat: comparisonOperator now IS the printed set, so the START-only membership screen has nothing left to screen)
